applies_to: ONICON System-20 BTU meters with the RS485 BACnet MS/TP interface, used on chilled and hot water loops.
summary: The System-20 calculates thermal energy from a flow meter and a matched pair of supply and return temperature sensors. Over BACnet MS/TP it reports energy and flow rates, both temperatures, energy and volume totals, auxiliary pulse totals and a meter status code. In dual mode it keeps separate totals for two modes (for example heating and cooling), so the totals come in single mode, mode 1 and mode 2 sets.
notes: The manual lists each object by identifier and function; the Object_Name property is shown only as "Various". Names here are the printed function text.
Single mode objects accumulate when the meter runs in single mode; Mode 1 and Mode 2 objects accumulate in dual mode. BV 1 shows the active mode.
Units shown are the factory defaults. Energy can be kBtu, MBtu, ton-hours, kJ, MJ, kWh or MWh; volume gallons, liters, ft3 or m3; temperature °F or °C.
The protocol statement counts 10 analog inputs, but only AI 1 to AI 7 are described in the object table.
There is no read/write column per object. The reset BVs are marked W because writing 1 resets the total; the rest are shown as read-only.
The numbered MV 1 states skip 8; the State_Text list in the same section has Low Signal Quality in that position.

source.title: System-20 BTU Meter Installation and Operation Guide

integration.summary: Read the energy rate, flow rate and the two temperatures for live trending, plus the energy and volume totals for the mode the meter runs in. Watch MV 1 Meter Status for sensor and supply faults. Nothing needs to be written except the optional total resets.

setup: BACnet MS/TP on terminal block TB1, 2-wire half duplex, 1/4 unit load.
MAC address 1-255 per the specification (the display menu shows 0-127), default 17. Device instance default 57017, writable.
Baud 9600, 19200, 38400 or 76800; default 38400. 120 ohm termination selectable, default off; no biasing.
Protocol (BACnet or Modbus), address, instance and baud are set from the meter display menu.
gotchas: Pick the totals that match the operating mode: the single mode objects cover single mode, the mode 1 and mode 2 objects cover dual mode.
Reset the user-defined and aux totals only through the reset BVs (write 1).
The trend log multiple holds 120 records and rolls over; the interval can be set from 30 s to 1 h, default 15 min.
